crime: For weeks, {WITCH_NAME} and a partner played pool each afternoon. The partner demonstrated bank shots; {WITCH_NAME} racked the balls. Neither started a rack alone. Then {WITCH_NAME} watched the partner give a cellmate the cue, repeat beginner shots, and promise another practice the next afternoon. {WITCH_NAME} left before the rack ended.

That evening, {WITCH_NAME} visited the partner's cell with nothing in her hands; the cellmate saw her arrive. Facing the lower bunk and folding its bedding, the partner said, “Don't wake me after your shower. I'm going to sleep.” The cellmate left for the shower. {WITCH_NAME} stayed.

Another prisoner waited outside the solo cell to speak with {WITCH_NAME} throughout the shower and saw no corridor traffic. {WITCH_NAME} stood beside the prisoner when the cellmate returned along the basement corridor. {WITCH_NAME}'s distinctive cuff had a torn underside seam crossed by a narrow blood line, which the prisoner saw at close range. The cellmate left the covered shape on the lower bunk untouched, shut the door, and slept above after lockup.
The next morning, the cellmate uncovered the partner dead, the sword buried through her upper back to the guard.

A blood-stiffened thread in the sword guard matched the missing cuff piece. Rejoined, their blood line proved the thread was attached when the wound bled onto the guard, and the wound between the shoulder blades ruled out self-harm. The pre-return sighting excluded the cellmate. {WITCH_NAME} stayed beside the prisoner until the shared-cell door closed, after which its frame could not carry {WITCH_NAME} back.

Earlier, {WITCH_NAME} carried the sword through connected frames from the lounge to her solo cell. During the shower, she teleported there from the shared cell, retrieved it, returned with it, pressed folded bedding over the partner's mouth, drove the blade into the chest, covered the body, and teleported back before the cellmate returned.
fields.epitaph: Every doorway let her leave first; none opened onto a place that would keep her.
fields.epithet: The Place Saved for Someone Else
execution: A wide conveyor runs between high steel rails that narrow toward two counter-rotating steel rollers. She starts on her feet as the belt moves. She tries either side, but the smooth rails curve inward and close off both routes.

The belt carries her feet into the gap. The rollers grip her ankles and pull, dropping her onto the belt and drawing in her legs feet-first. They crush her knees, pelvis, abdomen, chest, shoulders, and skull in turn. Her whole body passes between the rollers and emerges beyond them flattened, dead from complete mechanical crushing.

magic.name: Doorframe Teleportation
magic.text: She can connect two doorframes she has touched and teleport between them.
